name: postwith
title: postwith
blurb: an atproto matchmaker, Lunchclub-style but peer-to-peer: post a topic and a goal (mentoring, gaming, foodie, code, ...), get auto-matched with everyone else on the same topic, propose a meeting, they accept or decline, either side logs how it went. every record — profile, proposal, response, feedback — is written straight to your own PDS; a Durable Object just watches the firehose to build the live match index. @antiali.as asked for a matchmaker; "execute flawlessly" kept it going.
